label: Identifier
definition: The row id of the record, by which other records reference it. On a specimen row it is the catalog number and persists; on a part row it is file-local and discarded after import. Unique within the file across all rows, compared case-sensitively after trimming.
specimen_part: REQUIRED if another row references it (intermediate part), otherwise empty
usage_notes: Never derive a part-row id from a row ordinal: it can collide with a catalog number. Use <catalog_number>-<suffix> (e.g. DEMO-003-A) or a UUID.

label: Is Part Of
definition: The id of the record this part belongs to. Empty on a specimen row, non-empty on a part row: this column alone classifies the record. Must equal the id of another row in the same file, and following the chain must reach a specimen row with no self-reference or cycle.
usage_notes: Depth is unlimited: a part may point at an intermediate part rather than the specimen row. Row order carries no structure.

label: Material Category
definition: The top-level class of the material described by the row, from the Geological Specimen Material Category vocabulary (https://kos.geospecimens.org/vocab/geological-specimen-material-category).
usage_notes: Set independently on each row. Never copy a parent category to its parts or overwrite a parent to match them: a Rock resolving into Mineral parts is the ordinary case.

label: Material Subcategory
definition: A subdivision of material_category that narrows the class of the material described by the row.
usage_notes: Set independently on each row; never copied from a parent.

label: Cataloged Name
definition: The name of the specimen as a whole as recorded in the collection catalogue, often a delimited list of its materials.
usage_notes: A specimen property: a consumer disregards it on part rows.

label: Authoritative Name
definition: A name from a formal nomenclature, assigned by an authoritative body on defined criteria, for the material described by the row.
usage_notes: On a compound specimen row it may be empty, the materials being named on the part rows. If a main part is named there instead, do not repeat it as a part row.

label: Verbatim Name
definition: The name as written on the label or in the source record, where it differs from authoritative_name.

label: Collection Code
definition: Collection code as reported by GRSciColl.
usage_notes: Catalog numbers are unique per collection, not across collections: carry collection_code on every row and resolve is_part_of within one collection only.

label: Institution Code
definition: Institution code as reported by GRSciColl.

label: Locality Description
definition: A description of the place where the specimen was collected.
examples: Invented Valley, Nowhere District, Republic of Example
usage_notes: A specimen property: every part inherits the locality of its specimen, so do not repeat it on part rows.
